headline: Morocco Household Non-Performing Loans Rise to MAD 44.3 Billion
summary: Non-performing loans held by Moroccan households rose 5% year-on-year to MAD 44.3 billion at the end of September, according to Bank Al-Maghrib data, indicating borrower stress despite lower lending rates.
why: Bank Al-Maghrib tracks non-performing loans to evaluate credit risk stability within North Africa's banking sector.

impacts.name: Morocco
impacts.why: Rising consumer non-performing debt stresses retail bank balance sheets in Morocco.
